title: The Math of Solvency: Decoupling Rural Hospital Revenue from RVU Volume
summary: A fiscal deep dive into the 'Fee-for-Service' death spiral affecting Vermont's rural providers. We propose an economic framework for fixed prospective payments to stabilize Critical Access Hospitals.

children.text: When revenue is tied to Relative Value Units (RVUs), rural hospitals are penalized for success in preventative care. By shifting to a fixed global budget, we stabilize the P&L and allow clinicians to focus on maximizing health rather than churning patient visits.
Economic stability in rural health isn't about finding more patients; it's about changing how we value the absence of them.

body.caption: A graph illustrating the 'Scissors Effect' of rising fixed costs and falling RVU revenue in rural settings.
